core_cases.prompt: Create notes/release.md as Obsidian Flavored Markdown. Add YAML properties for title "Release Plan", date 2026-07-27, tags project/release and visibility/internal, and alias "Launch Plan". Include a [[Deployment Checklist|checklist]] wikilink, embed assets/diagram.png at width 400, add a collapsed warning callout titled "Rollback", preserve a final paragraph with block ID ^approval, and include an Obsidian comment containing "draft-owner".

oracle.expected_outcome: The note has parseable top-of-file YAML with the requested typed values and valid Obsidian syntax for the wikilink, image embed, collapsed titled callout, block ID, and comment.

assertions.description: frontmatter parses and contains the requested title, date, two tags, and alias
the note contains [[Deployment Checklist|checklist]] and ![[assets/diagram.png|400]] without converting either target to a filesystem path
the note contains a collapsed warning callout with title Rollback and quoted body content
the note contains block ID ^approval and an Obsidian comment containing draft-owner

core_cases.prompt: Add status: active to the YAML properties in notes/broken.md. The opening frontmatter has no closing delimiter, so it is ambiguous where properties end and note content begins. Report that structural blocker and leave the note unchanged rather than guessing a repair.

oracle.expected_outcome: The response identifies the missing closing YAML delimiter, does not claim the properties parse, and preserves the note byte-for-byte.

assertions.description: reports that the initial YAML frontmatter lacks a closing delimiter
does not choose an arbitrary line as the end of frontmatter
does not modify notes/broken.md after detecting the ambiguity

fixtures.content:
---
title: Broken Note
tags:
  - project
# This may be content or malformed YAML
Body text follows.

core_cases.prompt: Edit notes/existing.md by adding a success callout titled "Verified" after the checklist paragraph. Preserve the unknown frontmatter key review-owner, the existing [[Runbook#Rollback|rollback guide]] wikilink, the ^checklist block ID, the %% keep-this %% comment, and the ordinary Markdown table exactly.

oracle.expected_outcome: A valid success callout is added in the requested location while all named existing properties and Markdown/Obsidian constructs remain unchanged.

assertions.description: the edited note contains a > [!success] Verified callout after the checklist paragraph
the wikilink, ^checklist block ID, and %% keep-this %% comment are unchanged
review-owner remains dana and the existing Markdown table is unchanged
modifies only notes/existing.md and does not rewrite unrelated content
